## Abyssal Basilisk (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
 CE Large outsider (augmented magical beast, extraplanar)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., *detect good*, low-light vision; Perception +11  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 22, touch 8, flat-footed 22 (-1 Dex, +12 natural, -1 size)  
 **hp** 288 (18d10+108)  
 **Fort** +18, **Ref** +12, **Will** +8  
 **DR** 10/magic; **Resist** cold 10, fire 10; **SR** 23  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 20 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +25 (2d8+7), 2 claws +24 (1d6+7)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** petrifying gaze, smite good  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 18th; concentration +20)  
 
  Constant—*[detect good](../../magic/spells/detect-good.md)*  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 24, **Dex** 8, **Con** 21, **Int** 3, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 15  
 **Base Atk** +18; **CMB** +26; **CMD** 35 (47 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Alertness, Blind-Fight, Great Fortitude, Improved Natural Attack (bite), Iron Will, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Weapon Focus (bite), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness.*  
 **Skills** Climb +16, Perception +11, Sense Motive +2, Stealth +4; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Stealth (when not moving in natural settings)  
 **Languages** none  
 **SQ** magic natural attack  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Petrifying Gaze (Ex)**  Permanently turn to stone, DC 21 Fortitude, range 30 feet. The save DC is Charisma-based.  
 
 **Smite Good (Su)**  Once per day, the abyssal greater basilisk can smite a good creature with a melee attack, dealing a +2 to hit and damage and an extra 18 points of damage.  
 
 

**Ecology**

 
**Environment** any (the Abyss)  
 **Organization** solitary or colony (3-6)  
 **Treasure** standard
